children: Rocket Lab (RKLB) posted Q3 revenue of $267.8 million, up 73% year over year and above estimates, but its 12-cent per-share loss was wider than expected. Backlog rose 52% to $3.57 billion.
Rocket Lab agreed to acquire Iridium for about $8 billion, funded by a completed share offering. Closing is expected by mid-2027, pending regulatory approval; Iridium shareholders approved the deal.
Rocket Lab challenged NASA’s award of a Mars communications contract worth up to $700 million to Blue Origin, citing eligibility and technical review concerns. The GAO decision is due Dec. 21.
Rocket Lab’s twin ESCAPADE spacecraft completed Mars-bound burns Nov. 7 and 9 with over 99% accuracy. Mars orbit entry is set for September 2027, with science work due in 2028.
Globalstar asked the FCC to review potential conflicts if Rocket Lab acquires Iridium, citing Rocket Lab’s access to its satellite designs and schedules. Globalstar said it does not oppose the deal.
• Rocket Lab Corporation (RKLB) said 12 of its built spacecraft launched during the quarter and entered operation, while more than 55 spacecraft were in development or production.
